Name: Joel, Son of Azariah
Summary: Joel, son of Azariah of the Kohathites, was one of the Levites who arose to cleanse the house of the LORD under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: The Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites.
RelatedPeople: Azariah, Father of Joel; King Hezekiah
LifeLesson: Two Levites named together began eight days of cleansing.
